heroCommands.comment: Build your profile in Claude Code

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: AI Job Search is an open-source job application framework built on Claude Code. You fill in your profile once, then commands search job portals, evaluate how well a posting fits you, tailor your CV and cover letter as PDFs, and prepare you for interviews.
sixtySeconds.problem: Writing a tailored CV and cover letter for every application takes hours, and it's hard to judge which jobs are worth applying to. This framework gives Claude Code a structured workflow for evaluating fit and drafting and reviewing applications.
whoFor: Job seekers comfortable with a terminal
Claude Code subscribers or API users
Applicants in any country (portal skills are community-provided)
People who want tailored LaTeX CVs and cover letters
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a structured, Claude Code-based job search with a drafter and reviewer pipeline. Claude Code has no free tier, and the project is independent of Anthropic.
requirements: Claude Code (a Claude Pro, Max or Team subscription, or Anthropic API credits)
A minimal LaTeX install with lualatex and xelatex (TinyTeX or MiKTeX)

overview: The core workflow is three commands. /setup builds your profile from your documents folder, a pasted CV or an interview. /scrape searches job portals that match your profile, deduplicates and sorts results by fit. /apply evaluates a posting, then drafts, reviews and compiles a tailored CV and cover letter.

More commands extend it: /rank scores a scrape into a shortlist, /interview builds a prep pack and runs a mock interview, /outcome records results and drafts follow-ups, and /gmail-sync proposes status updates from Gmail, among others. The workflow is language- and country-agnostic; job board search skills come from a separate community-portals repository, and without one /scrape uses web search.

The README warns that /setup writes personal data into tracked files, and GitHub forks of public repos are always public. It recommends a private copy for your own search and forking only to contribute. Other agents like Codex and Gemini CLI can start from AGENTS.md.

steps.title: Clone and push to your own private repo
steps.body: Replace your-user with your GitHub username.
steps.code:
gh repo clone ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
cd ai-job-search
git remote rename origin upstream
gh repo create ai-job-search --private --source=. --remote=origin --push
gh repo set-default your-user/ai-job-search

steps.title: Install the requirements
steps.body: Python 3.10+, Bun and a LaTeX install with lualatex and xelatex.

steps.title: Fork and clone
steps.body: Forks of public repos are public, so don't put personal data in one.
steps.code:
gh repo fork ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search --clone
cd ai-job-search
